content.short: Möbius Exchange is a StableSwap DEX on Mantle purpose-built for low-slippage trading of stablecoins and liquid staking tokens.
content.description: Möbius Exchange is a specialized decentralized exchange optimized for trading pegged assets such as stablecoins and liquid staking tokens (LSTs), using a StableSwap invariant formula that minimizes slippage and impermanent loss for correlated asset pairs. This provides superior trading conditions compared to general-purpose AMMs for stable asset swaps. Purpose-built for Mantle, Möbius targets the growing stablecoin and LRT trading market on the network.
